name: Willowbrook Plaza
summary: Willowbrook Plaza is a fully-leased, 401,574-square-foot shopping center located on the ring road of Willowbrook Mall in Wayne, New Jersey. The center features upmarket retailers and casual dining options with excellent access to Routes 46 and 23, serving one of northern New Jersey's most affluent communities.
demographics: Willowbrook Plaza serves an affluent suburban trade area with a median household income of $128,648 within 3 miles and $113,722 within 5 miles. The primary market consists of upper-middle-class families with average household incomes exceeding $150,000 in the immediate vicinity, reflecting Wayne's status as an established, prosperous New Jersey community. The center attracts a diverse mix of local residents and commuters from the heavily trafficked Route 46 and Route 23 corridors, with a daytime population of over 83,000 within 3 miles indicating strong employment centers nearby. Shoppers typically seek convenient access to upmarket retailers and casual dining options, with the center benefiting from its strategic location on the ring road of the larger Willowbrook Mall.
description: Willowbrook Plaza is a premier 401,574-square-foot shopping center strategically positioned in the heart of Wayne, New Jersey's thriving retail corridor. Located on the ring road of the renowned Willowbrook Mall at 77 Willowbrook Boulevard, this beautifully maintained center offers unparalleled convenience with direct access to the heavily trafficked Route 46 and Route 23, two of northern New Jersey's primary commercial arteries. The plaza serves one of the region's most affluent communities, drawing from a trade area where median household incomes exceed $128,000 within a 3-mile radius and the population reaches nearly 1.5 million within 10 miles. As part of Kimco Realty's portfolio of best-in-class properties, Willowbrook Plaza features familiar upmarket retailers alongside popular casual restaurants and cafes, creating a sophisticated shopping and dining destination. The center's fully leased status and strong 4.5-star rating from over 1,300 reviews underscore its enduring appeal to both tenants and visitors, while its position within the greater Willowbrook retail ecosystem ensures consistent traffic from discerning shoppers seeking quality brands and services in an accessible, well-maintained environment.
